table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	itemname= item.name,
	saleitemdesc= max(saledetail.saleitemdescription),
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc, 
	accname = accounts.name,   
	address =  customer.address1,
	address2=  customer.address2,   
	city=  customer.city,   
	licenceno=  customer.licenceno,   
	username=  users.username,   
	Saleordercode =  saleledger.Saleordercode,   
	headerno =  saleledger.headerno, 
	headerinvno=saleledger.headerinvno,  
	date =  saleledger.date,   
	modifycounter =  saleledger.modifycounter, 
	invdiscperc =  saleledger.discperc,   
	misccharges =  saleledger.misccharges,   
	flatdisc =  saleledger.flatdisc,   
	
	gcode = saledetail.gcode,   
	icode = saledetail.icode,   
	looseqty = sum(saledetail.looseqty),
	bonusqty = sum(saledetail.bonusqty),

	packunits= saledetail.packunits,   
	saleprice= saledetail.saleprice,   
	discperc = saledetail.discperc,   
	
	itemflatdisc=saledetail.itemflatdisc,   
	Id = max( saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),   
	posted=saleledger.posted,   
	balance=0,   
	unitsalestax = max(saledetail.unitsalestax),
	gstperc = max(saledetail.gstperc),
	invgstperc = saleledger.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	 saleledger.custrefno,	
	custref2=saleledger.custrefno2,
	 saleledger.remarks,
	amt=max(saleledger.amt),
	salesman=ltrim(rtrim( salesman.name)),
	manufacturer=(select name from manufacturer where manfcode=item.manfcode),
	CUSTALIAS=ACCOUNTS.ALIASNAME,
	patientname=(select name from patient where patientcode=saleledger.patientcode),
	patientaddress=(select address1 from patient where patientcode=saleledger.patientcode)
	
FROM 
	saleorderheader saleledger
	LEFT OUTER JOIN SalesMan ON (saleledger.smancode = salesman.salesmancode),
	saleorderdetail saledetail,   
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item 
WHERE 
	(  saleledger.Saleordercode=:ar_InvCode) AND
	(  saleledger.Saleordercode=saledetail.Saleordercode) AND
	(  saleledger.custcode =  accounts.acccode ) AND  
	(  customer.custcode =  accounts.acccode ) AND  
	(  saleledger.Usercode =  users.usercode ) AND 
	 (  saledetail.icode =  item.icode)    
GROUP BY
	item.name,
	
	item.customicode,   
	item.packingdesc, 
	 accounts.name,   
	 customer.address1,
	 customer.address2,   
	 customer.city,   
	 customer.licenceno,   
	 users.username,   
	 saleledger.Saleordercode,   
	 saleledger.headerno, 
	saleledger.headerinvno,  
	 saleledger.date,   
	 saleledger.modifycounter, 
	 saleledger.discperc,   
	 saleledger.misccharges,   
	 saleledger.flatdisc,   
	
	saledetail.gcode,   
	saledetail.icode,
	saledetail.packunits, 
	saledetail.saleprice, 
	saledetail.discperc, 
	saledetail.itemflatdisc, 
	saleledger.posted, 
	saleledger.invgstperc1, 
	customer.salestaxregno, 
	 saleledger.custrefno,
	saleledger.custrefno2,
	 saleledger.remarks,

	 salesman.name,
	item.manfcode,
	ACCOUNTS.ALIASNAME,
	saleledger.patientcode,
	saleledger.patientcode
ORDER BY 
	Saleordercode,
	ID

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: t_23
objects.visible: 1	if(getrow()=rowcount() AND ((Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0) ) - amt) <> 0,1,0)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  +  misccharges   , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: compute_6
objects.visible: 1	if(getrow() = rowcount() AND ((Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  +  misccharges   , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0) ) - amt) <> 0, 1, 0)
objects.expression: (Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  +  misccharges   , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0) ) - amt

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  (saleprice  - itemflatdisc) )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )   for group 1)
